notes.title: Tri-Star Version 1.3 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.3 Update:
- Alternate Models for every ship. Comes with different weapon loadouts.
- Customizable HUD elements, change the look of the status display area.
- Over 20 different color and patterns to unlock through normal play.
- Increased variety in enemy formations.
- Increased variety in enemy aesthetics.
- Updated UI elements.
- Minor Bug Fixes.

notes.title: Tri-Star Version 1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
A quick update to handle some known issues.
 - Fixed an issue that prevented players from progressing.
 - Fixed mouse click detection on some buttons on the Main Menu.

notes.title: Tri-Star Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.2 Update:
- Sunset Rider, Viridian Warrior and Fatal Scarlet added as unlockable ships.
- Player Ships at low health now spew sparks and puffs of smoke.
- Player Ships now have a yellow shield around them when 'Hold Together' is active.
- Enemies now drop orange and blue particles when the player has 'Weapon Master' and 'Phantom' respectively.
- Attacks with status effects now have special visual effects.
- An option to lower the brightness of the background has been added.
- New animations added to the small pieces of Scrap.
- Other minor bug fixes and corrections.

notes.title: Tri-Star Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.1 Update:
 - Keyboard and Controller buttons can now be reconfigured in the main menu.
 - D-Pad on Controllers are now supported for movement and menu navigation.
 - All enemy projectiles should are now properly removed during the boss introduction cutscene.
 - Changed requirements to unlock score attack and ace mode.
 - Camera Shake can now be turned off in the options menu.
 - Difficulty adjustments.
 - Other minor bug fixes.
